findings.title: Missing Amount Validation in PayHere Webhook
findings.description: The design uses tolerance-based amount comparison (0.01) but requirements specify exact equality without tolerance.
findings.fix: Replace tolerance comparison with exact integer cents comparison: expectedAmountCents !== callbackAmountCents

findings.title: Missing Merchant ID Validation
findings.description: The design mentions merchant_id validation but the code snippet is incomplete and no validation exists in current codebase.
findings.fix: Add explicit merchant_id validation against process.env.PAYHERE_MERCHANT_ID

findings.title: Missing Idempotency Key in Design
findings.description: The idempotency check only looks at final status but doesn't prevent race conditions if processing is interrupted.
findings.fix: Use atomic findOneAndUpdate with processing state for true idempotency

findings.title: Token Blocklist Assumes Redis Availability
findings.description: Design assumes Redis is available but grep_search found no Redis usage in codebase. Redis infrastructure may not exist.
findings.fix: Use MongoDB as primary storage, Redis as optional cache, or deploy Redis infrastructure

findings.title: hasEventAccess in attendees.js Misses mainOrganisers Array
findings.description: The hasEventAccess function in attendees.js does not check the mainOrganisers array, but the design's userHasEventAccess does.
findings.fix: Update hasEventAccess in attendees.js to include: event.mainOrganisers?.some(id => id.toString() === user._id.toString())

findings.title: Login Already Uses Generic Error Messages
findings.description: The design proposes adding generic error messages but verification shows this is already implemented.
findings.fix: Remove Section 2.11 or mark as 'Already Implemented - No action required'

findings.title: QR Token Lookup Endpoint Does Not Exist
findings.description: Design references GET /attendees/by-qr/:qrToken but grep_search found no such endpoint in codebase.
findings.fix: Clarify whether this endpoint needs to be created or identify the correct existing endpoint

findings.title: Socket.IO Lacks Authentication Middleware
findings.description: Design proposes adding JWT auth to Socket.IO but current server.js has no authentication on connections at all.
findings.fix: Add Socket.IO authentication middleware and update frontend to pass JWT tokens

findings.title: Existing Event Access Functions Are Inconsistent
findings.description: Three different files define three versions of event access functions with different logic.
findings.fix: Explicitly list files/functions to be replaced: attendees.js hasEventAccess, entry.js userHasEventAccess, rfid.js userHasEventAccess and canManageEvent

findings.title: Missing Redis Configuration Documentation
findings.description: Design assumes Redis is available but doesn't document configuration requirements.
findings.fix: Add Redis configuration documentation (REDIS_URL or REDIS_HOST/REDIS_PORT/REDIS_PASSWORD)

findings.title: Cash Payment Receipt Verification Incomplete
findings.description: Design mentions receipt verification endpoint but verification of actual implementation is incomplete.
findings.fix: Verify endpoint exists and functions correctly, or implement if missing

findings.title: Event Customization Persistence Frontend Not Addressed
findings.description: Design addresses backend APIs but doesn't specify which frontend components need API integration.
findings.fix: List specific frontend components needing migration: Gates, Team Members, Zones, Categories, Settings, RFID Settings, Payment Methods

verifiedAssumptions: Login error messages are already generic in auth.js
hasEventAccess functions exist in multiple route files
User model exists for user data
unverifiedAssumptions: Redis is available - no Redis usage found in codebase
GET /attendees/by-qr/:qrToken endpoint exists - not found in codebase
requireEventAccess middleware exists - not found in codebase
TokenBlocklist model exists - not found in codebase
